title: timbr 0.3.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-07-16 Fixed bug forests grouped root nodes (e.g. produced summarise()) error behave incorrectly downstream operations. children() now gives clear tidyselect error forest’s root nodes don’t share single node name, instead internal assertion failure. climb()’s .deep argument renamed .recurse (.deep now deprecated), recursion bug corrupt node bookkeeping climbing multiple levels fixed (#9). leaves() now correctly returns forests every node root leaf (e.g. single-level trees), instead erroring. map_forest() now defunct throws error; use traverse() instead (deprecated since timbr 0.2.2). relocate() now implemented forests, moving columns preserving tree structure. rows_patch() rows_update() now implemented forests, fixes -column matching error messages (#20). select() forests now always preserves internal node column, selecting feature columns longer breaks tree structure.
